objective: Convert a tail part's 8-bit alpha into a deterministic, connected, valid MeshSpec-0.1 without bones, weights, or Spine-specific output.
inScope: Single-region nonzero-alpha contour tracing and exact collinear simplification
Deterministic polygon triangulation, bounded internal vertex insertion, and oversized-triangle subdivision
Independent MeshSpec semantic/topology validator with structured error codes
Opt-in, total-budgeted alpha cleanup with exact discarded and filled pixel counts
mesh-png and mesh-asset CLI commands, portable golden fixture, synthetic negative cases, and private real-tail smoke evidence
outOfScope: Bone, joint, skin weight, IK, constraint, animation, AI, preview engine, and Spine mesh serialization
Multi-region or unbounded hole meshing, inferred art cleanup, and claims of artist-approved deformation quality
implementationSummary: The mesh package depends only on schemas and Earcut, not AI, Spine, or the assets package. It traces exposed pixel-cell edges of one 4-connected nonzero-alpha region, rejects self-touching loops and holes, removes exact collinear corners, triangulates the ordered concave hull, inserts row-major interior grid points only strictly inside existing triangles, and subdivides triangles larger than 512 raster pixel squared at their centroid. It converts raster vertices to part display bounds and UVs to full-raster coordinates. The independent validator checks schema, finite values, UVs, duplicate vertices, index bounds, degenerate and duplicate triangles, hull self-intersection, edge incidence and winding, T-junctions/crossings, triangle adjacency, and area conservation. Strict mode never discards pixels; optional preprocessing with a caller-selected combined fraction reports detached pixels, bridged pinches, and filled enclosed holes. Input arrays and source images are not modified.
externalAlgorithmEvidence: Mapbox Earcut's official README states the library assumes valid polygon rings, does not guarantee correctness on arbitrary input, and can produce nonconforming output; this is why AutoSpine rejects invalid alpha topology and independently validates the result: https://github.com/mapbox/earcut/blob/main/README.md

checks.name: clean install and full verification
checks.evidence: npm ci --ignore-scripts completed from package-lock.json, reported 0 vulnerabilities; npm run verify passed Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript build/typecheck, 5 Vitest files and 34 tests. All 25 earlier Gate 0-2 tests remain in the passing suite. git diff --check passed.

checks.name: portable golden and deterministic synthetic tail
checks.evidence: A code-defined tapered curved tail alpha with a concave outline equals fixtures/tail/synthetic.expected.json in full MeshSpec content. Schema and topology validation pass; internal vertices are present. Re-running generation 100 additional times produces byte-identical JSON and does not mutate the AssetPart input.

checks.name: negative alpha and cleanup budget
checks.evidence: Tests reject empty alpha, separate 4-connected islands, diagonal-only contact, enclosed holes, and corner pinches in strict mode. Separate tests show detached component selection, corner repair, and hole filling require explicit budgets, return exact counts, and preserve original arrays.

checks.name: independent mesh validator
checks.evidence: Mutating a valid mesh proves rejection of invalid indices, duplicate vertices, repeated-index degenerate triangles, a self-crossing hull, duplicate triangles, out-of-range UV, disconnected triangle graph, and a T-junction. A 128 by 128 tapered triangle test verifies maximum raster triangle area <=512 and connected topology. Single-pixel and nonuniform display scaling checks verify pixel-edge positions, concave hull convention, and full-raster UVs.

checks.name: private real-tail integration
checks.evidence: Read-only studio Tail.png is 294x530 pixels, source SHA-256 B62426BE390AD824DB5A691C63B9E38A61DB52405BD5AF105164C2E48BF8B7F6. Strict mode reported 27 disconnected components; largest had 81,635 of 81,789 nonzero-alpha pixels. With an explicit 0.5% combined change budget, cleanup discarded 154 detached pixels, bridged 1 corner, and filled 5 one-pixel holes (160/81,789 = 0.1956%). The final mesh had 1,214 vertices, 950 ordered hull vertices, and 1,476 triangles; independent validator passed. Triangle areas ranged from 0.5 to 504 raster pixels squared and summed to 81,641, exactly the corrected foreground area within floating-point tolerance. Source file and derived mesh are not committed.

checks.name: private real-tail determinism and CLI
checks.evidence: After one read-only parse and cleanup, 100 additional full mesh generations serialized byte-identically; minified output SHA-256 3a0cc4cc6c61c4b9e134376156b3f27bf0fa9e6293d08f89009261924c2d8b0e. Direct CLI mesh-png after clean install emitted the same 1,214-vertex/1,476-triangle valid MeshSpec and printed exact cleanup counts. Local mesh-asset CLI converted a Gate 2 golden AssetSpec; a second invocation refused to overwrite the existing output. Temporary derived files were removed.

checks.name: prior Gate regression and boundaries
checks.evidence: The earlier 25 tests for schema contracts, Gate 1 Spine 4.0.64 compiler/runtime/CLI and Gate 2 PNG/PSD parsers remain passing. MeshSpec schema ID and shape are unchanged; packages/core, packages/assets, and packages/spine implementations are unchanged. The new mesh package depends on schemas and Earcut only; CLI calls assets and mesh without hosting geometry.

knownLimitations: Gate 3 makes a structurally valid starter mesh, not an artist-approved deformation; root/middle/wave pose metrics and visual inspection are Gate 6 work after rig and weights exist.

The single outer-contour MeshSpec cannot encode genuine transparent holes or multiple separated art regions; strict mode rejects them. Small imperfections may be changed only with an explicit caller budget and exact diagnostics.

Simplification removes exactly collinear pixel edges only. The private 294x530 tail retains 950 hull vertices; density and edge flow can be refined in later quality Gates without weakening this Gate's correctness baseline.

The private art file cannot be included in the repository. Portable synthetic golden/tests verify behavior everywhere; the real-tail checksum and numeric results identify the additional local evidence.
On Windows, npm's command wrapper can alter UNC paths containing parentheses; directly invoking node packages/cli/dist/index.js mesh-png was verified for this private path.

definitionOfDone.criterion: Tail alpha becomes serializable, valid, deterministic MeshSpec
Contour, simplification, triangulation, and internal vertices have portable tests and golden output
No invalid index, zero-area triangle, self-intersection, T-junction, or disconnected mesh passes the validator
No AI rigging, weights, or later-Gate functionality is introduced
